scope: Public benchmark items explicitly reviewed for full-document serving in Lamezia Trasparente

policy.note: Documents that are useful for an internal benchmark but are not explicitly approved for full public serving must remain outside this committed manifest and outside Git.

items.selectionReason: Reviewed institutional commission document already used as a primary source in the public product. The outer PDF is a protocol wrapper containing the substantive convocazione as an embedded PDF.

wrapper.note: Both extract the protocol wrapper. Docling adds structured labels and picture references, but Markdown is not a lossless substitute for the structured JSON.

embeddedPdf.note: The current baseline returns effectively no substantive text. Docling recovers the commission heading, recipients, subject, dates and agenda items. Minor OCR/spacing defects remain possible and must not be treated as verified source text.
